record.question: Which software is used to start a computer?
record.explanation: Answer A: System software. Only System software among the four choices is software. Operating systems and startup components are system software; hardware, data and DNT are not software categories used to start a computer. The wording is broad, but the offered alternatives give one defensible choice. Reference: https://www.ibm.com/think/topics/operating-systems Independently reviewed worked solution, unofficial; no examiner key is asserted.
